race.title: Unibet Greatwood Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Unexposed LET IT RAIN and Harry Lowes head a remarkably strong hand for the Dan Skelton yard, with the former narrowly preferred off a mark that still looks lenient. The Hardest Geezer makes plenty of each-way appeal at the early prices, with last year's runner-up Helnwein set to be in the hunt for another in-frame finish. LET IT RAIN HARRY LOWES (IRE) THE HARDEST GEEZER (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Harry Lowes (10/3), Idaho Sun (4/1), Let It Rain (5/1), Pioneer Pete (6/1), Helnwein (10/1), Mister Ursus (10/1), The Kemble Brewery (10/1), Burdett Road (10/1), The Mighty Celt (16/1), Captain Hugo (16/1), Tennessee Tango (20/1), Race To Base (20/1), The Hardest Geezer (20/1), Day Trader (20/1), Serious Challenge (20/1), Iberico Lord (33/1), Morning Mayhem (33/1), Give It To Me Oj (33/1), Listentoyourheart (66/1), Knickerbockerglory (66/1)
